jsonTools.label: Guided Redlines

catalog.title: GUIDED REDLINES
catalog.desc: Experimental: step through every tracked change one at a time (Build-Draft guided style). Each revision shows net impact, an AI audit of what materially changed, team guidance, and accept/reject/revise. Read-only — never edits the doc. Admin-only.
catalog.hoverTip: Walk redlines one revision at a time (experimental)
catalog.action: if (window.eli && window.eli.dispatch) window.eli.dispatch('tile', 'app_guided_redlines'); else if (typeof showGuidedRedlines === 'function') showGuidedRedlines(window.eli); else if (typeof showToast === 'function') showToast('Guided Redlines not loaded.', 'error');
